method: Two processes, Linux loopback, policy backend, no TLS/compression. RSS is cumulative process high-water including separate JSON codec samples; No TCP baseline. RPC percentiles include local codec; 20 warmups plus one untimed response validation per case. Policy mode measures synthetic uint8 images in, float32 actions out, with a client deep-copy snapshot before each RPC. It excludes camera capture, learned inference, RTC scheduling, action preparation and hardware execution. Budget exceedances refer only to snapshot + RPC, not real RTC deadline violations.
